parsed.ceo_summary: We are hardening our CI/CD pipeline by introducing a dedicated verification utility to guarantee network and logging reliability.
constraints: Must run in headless mode with no GUI dependencies
Must implement structured JSON logging for machine-readability
Must provide a minimal HTTP echo endpoint that returns request payloads
Must be compatible with the existing PROJECT_SMOKE_COMMAND infrastructure
Must support a fast startup and shutdown cycle for CI efficiency
parsed.cpo_summary: We will build a minimal, deterministic HTTP echo server that serves as a reliable anchor for our automated smoke test suite.
parsed.rationale: A lightweight CLI utility is optimal for headless CI environments, providing a low-overhead way to spin up a verification target and validate logging pipelines without requiring a full service deployment.

parsed.build_notes: Utilize CMake with MSVC, targeting C++20. Integrate into existing build.bat. Use a lightweight header-only HTTP library (e.g., cpp-httplib) to minimize binary footprint and startup latency.
parsed.cto_summary: We will implement a high-performance C++20 headless echo server with structured JSON logging to provide a deterministic verification anchor for the CI smoke-test suite.
risks: Port contention in parallel CI runners
Network timeout synchronization in headless environments
